Core programs 'MSc Management', 'Executive MBA Paris', 'Bachelor in International Business', 'Bachelor in Marketing and Communication', 'Bachelor in Digital Business', 'MSc Marketing Strategy', 'MSc Finance and Accounting', 'MSc Entrepreneurship and Innovation', 'MSc Human Resources Management' do not appear on the official site and look fabricated/templated.

Scholarships fabricated: catalog claims 'Excellence Scholarship Up to EUR 3,000' and 'International Diversity Award EUR 1,500'. Official scholarships are percentage-based (up to 50% all 2026 intakes; Excellence Scholarship 90% of tuition; 50% LATAM). Amounts and names do not match.
Second campus entry 'EMA - Paris Campus' is an empty/duplicate placeholder (only title+img, no text).
Accommodation entries are generic Russian-language marketing text with no official housing program named; not verifiable on official site.

evidence: Official site https://ema.education/ (EMA, founded 2004, 98 rue Didot, 75014 Paris; tel +33 1 75 43 95 15; contact@ema.education). Programmes page (https://ema.education/en/programmes/) lists Bachelor Applied Management & Economics (3 yr), MBA Sustainable Leadership (2 yr), BTS Commerce International (RNCP41759, 2 yr), plus Sustainable Academy short courses; option-based bachelors exist e.g. https://ema.education/en/programmes/bachelor-en-management-applique-option-droit-des-affaires/. Official tuition ~EUR 7,000-10,000/yr (per scholarship/fees pages). No tuition/scholarship/accommodation figures on official site match catalog. Catalog sourceUrl points to wrong domain ema-paris.fr.
